Option1: "که پرسشی نکنی عندلیب شیدا را - غرور حسنت اجازت ... ای گل" Something about not asking the mad nightingale, pride of beauty, permission not given, O flower. Seems about love, beauty, pride.

Option2: "بحر توحید و غرقه در گنهیم - هوشیار حضور و مست غرور" Sea of monotheism and we are drowned in sin? Awake presence and drunk pride. Mix of spirituality and pride.

Option3: "دور از دیار خویش در اینجا چگونه ای - هیچ از مقام اصلی خود یاد می کنی" Far from homeland here how... you never remember your original rank. About exile, identity.

Option4: "سلیمان نباشد گران سر به مور - نبودی سرش پایبند غرور" Something about Solomon not being heavy-headed? Not sure. Might be about arrogance.

We need which one differs conceptually. Options 1,2,4 seem about pride/arrogance (غرور). Option3 about exile and forgetting origin. So likely option3 is outlier.
